audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Urgot all seven rows, while whys[0] says level 1 is even and whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say full-tank Malphite overtakes him. The packet reads Skill / Urgot x5 / Malphite.
audit.why: Granite Shield makes the level-1 trade a wash, and past two items Malphite's armour stacking outruns Purge's shred while his ultimate becomes a flash-engage. A chart claiming Urgot wins the two-item row directly contradicts the page's own closing advice to end the game first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The only cooldown named on the page is 'Unstoppable Force: saved for fights', with no number, and the real lane-tax ability is never given one at all.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1 falling to 100s. But Ground Slam is a 7s flat cooldown that reduces attack speed — against a champion whose damage comes from autos and Purge triggering Echoing Flames, that is the cooldown that decides every trade, and it went unmentioned.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now carry both the 130s and the 7s attack-speed slam.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) Three fields invoke 'Q's execute portion' / 'Q's outer-ring execute' — Corrosive Charge is damage plus a slow in Riot's text, with no execute anywhere. (b) Granite Shield's actual rule — it absorbs up to 10% of his max health and RECHARGES if he has not been hit for a few seconds — appears nowhere, despite the page telling you to shred it. (c) Thunderclap's on-hit aftershocks are described only as 'his W autos'.
audit.why: The recharge is the whole interaction: chip him continuously and the shield never returns, back off for a few seconds and you have to pay for it again. Without that sentence 'shred his shield' is an instruction with no timing attached. And the fabricated Q execute has now appeared in two separate matchups on this champion, so it looks systemic rather than local.
audit.corrected: Q described as the 800-range slow feeding Purge; Granite Shield's 10% cap and recharge stated in dontsFull[2].d; Thunderclap's on-hit aftershocks and 400 range stated in dontsFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit P text and percentHealth flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Malphite's Q and E both carry a derived 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' flag in the kit file.
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions say Seismic Shard steals move speed and Ground Slam deals magic damage and reduces attack speed. Neither mentions grounding. Per the standing rule, the description wins over a derived flag.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim was made anywhere in the rewrite; recorded here so a later pass does not 'restore' it from the flag.
